Durante ocorrências, o supervisor presta apoio direto à equipe, atuando em casos como invasões, furtos ou acidentes, acionando as autoridades competentes quando necessário e registrando os fatos de forma clara e precisa.

Mantém contato frequente com os responsáveis nos locais de vigilância, avaliando a satisfação do cliente em relação aos serviços prestados e repassando os feedbacks à gestão. Além disso, realiza inspeções surpresa para verificar a conduta dos vigilantes, o cumprimento de horários e a execução correta das rotinas nos postos.

title: Comprador Corporativo Sr
description:
Sua missão como Comprador Corporativo Sr será:

  • Monitorar e analisar as variáveis (mercado, demandas e custo) de forma a prevenir e antecipar ameaças de desabastecimento e identificar e garantir as oportunidades.
  • Realizar avaliação do mercado fornecedor, identificando oportunidades, carências, forças e fraquezas mediante a realização de benchmarking, buscando a melhoria contínua.
  • Assegurar a maximização dos benefícios para a OMNI, através da elaboração de macroestratégias de aquisição por família/grupo de compras, propondo as abordagens e buscando minimizar os problemas futuros com a adequada estratégia de comunicação com o mercado fornecedor.
  • Promover o levantamento e consolidação contínua de informações que permitam priorizar e caracterizar as famílias que serão parte do processo de gestão estratégica, bem como a análise do perfil do mercado fornecedor.
  • Propor estratégias de contratação de equipamentos, materiais, serviços, buscando geração de valor, baixo custo e/ou baixo TCO (Total Cost of Ownership), garantia de abastecimento, e inovação a projetos e operações.
  • Analisar, discutir e elaborar planejamento, programação e controle de atividades de Suprimentos de alta complexidade para a implantação de empreendimentos, que devem refletir a estratégia de aquisições a serem consideradas em estreita consonância com a estratégia/cronogramas de implantação da OMNI, através de suas áreas requisitantes.
  • Elaborar o planejamento da demanda de materiais e serviços em conjunto com a área de negócio e/ou requisitante, tanto para custeio como para investimento, fornecendo as informações de mercado, históricos de consumo, estratégias de compra, prazos para compra, entre outras.
  • Elaborar, em conjunto com as áreas de negócio e/ou requisitantes, os procedimentos de testes, qualificação e homologação de fornecedores para produtos e serviços para futuros contratos com a OMNI.
  • Contribuir para a criação do portfólio de fornecedores, através da participação em visitas, reuniões com fornecedores e da avaliação dos fornecedores para cotação e posterior seleção de fornecedores qualificados para negociação.
  • Assegurar a seleção dos fornecedores competitivos, através do desenvolvimento de estratégias, definição das equipes e papéis, preparação da negociação, recomendação de fornecedores e da implementação das mudanças e acordos necessários com as áreas de negócio e/ou requisitantes.
  • Realizar a aquisição de produtos e serviços, através da formalização de contrato.
  • Promover consolidação de contratações, quando aplicável, em prol de ganhos em escala. Participar dos times multifuncionais para aquisição, visando assegurar o atendimento de necessidades internas de clientes (qualidade, prazo, etc.), a melhoria de especificações, testes, etc. e na fase pós-aquisição, avaliando os testes de novos materiais e sua aplicação pelos usuários.
  • Acompanhar execução contratual com os gestores, monitorando KPIs com objetivo de avaliar aderência, obter previsibilidade e mitigar riscos à OMNI.
  • Efetuar a coleta de informações, análise crítica, desenvolvimento e implementação de plano de ação para fornecedores que estejam em potencial risco (ex.: insolvência, inadimplemento contratual), minimizando assim o risco de desabastecimento para a OMNI.

title: Lead Thumbnail Designer
description:
Join to apply for the Lead Thumbnail Designer role at A Impact Media .

The position is remote and offers a competitive salary range of $42,000–$72,000 per year, depending on experience and team size managed.

Lead Thumbnail Designer | Remote

To Apply:

As the Lead Thumbnail Designer at Knwn Local, you will build and develop a team of 5–10+ thumbnail designers who create scroll‑stopping visuals that drive channel growth for America’s top real‑estate leaders. This is a player‑coach leadership role where you spend 60–80% of your time managing, mentoring, and building systems, and 20–40% hands‑on designing complex projects.

You will own design quality standards, team development, and creative operations across the agency, partnering closely with Pod Managers, the Creative Director, and leadership on strategic initiatives. Your success is measured by how well your team performs, grows, and delivers results that drive client success, not by the number of thumbnails you design.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development (50–70% of role)

  • Directly manage 5–8 thumbnail designers with weekly 1‑on‑1 skill development sessions.
  • Lead bi‑weekly team design reviews with constructive feedback.
  • Build comprehensive onboarding programs and training materials for new hires.
  • Create career development pathways with clear promotion criteria.
  • Conduct performance reviews and manage accountability through the Clarify Instrument Coach Decide framework.
  • Handle hiring (write JDs, screen portfolios, interview, make offers).
  • Build 2–5+ year relationships with designers through proactive retention and engagement strategies.
  • Conduct skip‑level meetings with junior designers to assess team health and identify early warning signs.

Creative Excellence & Standards (20–30% of role)

  • Design 15–30 high‑impact thumbnails per month for VIP clients and complex projects.
  • Own and evolve agency‑wide creative quality standards, brand guidelines, and style guides.
  • Establish QA processes that maintain 90%+ first‑approval rate.
  • Lead A/B testing strategy and performance analysis across the client portfolio.
  • Serve as final creative approval for all thumbnails before client delivery.
  • Drive creative innovation through monthly experimentation initiatives and "Good Flops".
  • Create and maintain the design team’s template library and asset management systems.

Strategic Collaboration & Systems (10–20% of role)

  • Partner with Pod Managers on client strategy and creative direction for key accounts.
  • Present creative strategy and performance insights in monthly client strategy calls.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership on agency‑wide creative vision and initiatives.
  • Build scalable workflows, capacity planning, and resource allocation systems.
  • Create performance dashboards tracking team metrics (CTR, approval rates, turnaround times).
  • Document best practices, SOPs, and knowledge base for the design function.
  • Contribute to quarterly planning, annual strategy summits, and company OKRs.

Requirements

Leadership & Design Experience

  • 6+ years of professional design experience with 2+ years managing creative teams.
  • Proven track record leading, developing, and scaling design teams of 5+ people.
  • Minimum 3+ years creating high‑performing YouTube thumbnails with proven CTR results.
  • Experience hiring designers, conducting performance reviews, and managing accountability.
  • Portfolio showcasing thumbnails that contributed to channel growth (include CTR data).
  • Comfortable with difficult conversations (performance issues, firing, conflict resolution).

Technical & Strategic Skills

  • Expert‑level proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma (portfolio required).
  • Deep understanding of YouTube algorithms, CTR optimization, and viewer psychology.
  • Data‑driven approach with ability to interpret analytics and translate into design strategy.
  • Experience with A/B testing methodologies, performance analysis, and optimization.
  • Strong presentation skills for client‑facing strategy calls and executive meetings.
  • Understanding of creative team economics (capacity planning, resourcing, budgeting).

Communication & Cultural Leadership

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication for feedback, presentations, and documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to give feedback that accelerates growth and elevates work quality.
  • Extreme Ownership – takes full accountability for team results; never blames or makes excuses.
  • Beyond Excellence – sets impossibly high standards and inspires team to exceed them.
  • Proactive Curiosity – anticipates problems, asks better questions, and stays ahead of needs.
  • Mission Focus – obsesses about client success and team development over personal recognition.

# Results

Team Performance

  • Design team maintains 90%+ first‑approval rate across all designers.
  • Designer retention rate exceeds 85% annually with clear development and career progression.
  • New designers productive at 80% capacity within 30–60 days.
  • 100% of direct reports show measurable skill improvement quarter‑over‑quarter.
  • Team operates at 80–90% capacity utilization – productive output without burnout.

Quality & Impact

  • Zero client escalations due to design quality issues or missed deadlines.
  • Agency‑wide thumbnail CTR averages 5–10% (significantly above platform benchmarks).
  • 95%+ on‑time delivery rate across the entire team’s project portfolio.
  • Design workflows, templates, and style guides documented and adopted agency‑wide.
  • Team generates innovative thumbnail strategies that drive agency‑wide adoption.

Strategic Leadership

  • Design function viewed as strategic partner by Pod Managers and leadership.
  • Contribute to client strategy with design insights that drive performance.
  • Client satisfaction scores remain >4.5/5 for design quality and communication.
  • At least 1–2 designers promoted or advancement‑ready annually due to your mentorship.
  • Leadership views design as a strategic differentiator, not just an execution function.

Compensation & Growth

Salary & Benefits

  • Starting Range: $42,000 – $72,000 USD/year depending on experience and team size managed.
  • Fully Remote.
  • Flexible Time Off policy & Company‑Wide Holiday Breaks.
  • Professional development budget for courses, plugins, and creative tools.
  • Potential Health Insurance Reimbursement (after 60–90 day trial period).
  • Potential to earn Monthly wellness allowance.
  • Potential to earn Home office stipend for equipment and software.
  • Leadership development program.
  • Access to industry‑leading tools, plugins, and AI‑assisted editing software.
  • Clear career progression with transparent promotion criteria.

Performance Metrics You'll Own

  • Team Performance: Design Quality Score, First‑Approval Rate (90%+), CTR performance.
  • Team Development: Skill progression, promotion readiness, retention rate (85%+).
  • Operational Excellence: Capacity utilization (80–90%), on‑time delivery (95%+).
  • Strategic Impact: Innovation initiatives, process improvements, client satisfaction (>4.5/5).

Location

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO

Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. title: Network Solution Architect - Data and Voice

Network Solution Architect - Data and Voice

1GLOBAL is a technology‑driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best‑in‑class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital‑first businesses—including neo‑banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

Position Overview

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1GLOBAL, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.

We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities

  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer‑centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
  • Design and present solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution identifies the impacts, efforts and the resources needed
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry and identifying interesting solutions for the product portfolio
  • Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and / or alternatives
  • Ensure and control quality of documentation execution (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.)
  • Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non‑functional and functional state‑of‑the‑art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement

Requirements

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud‑based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big‑picture goals inform technical details and vice‑versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi‑cultural/multi‑country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year‑on‑year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

  • ✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long‑term success.

Job Description

We are looking for a Web Analyst to join our team and help us optimize the performance of over 25 B2B websites. As a key member for the web team, you will be responsible for analyzing user behaviour, tracking key website metrics, and providing actionable insights to improve MQL generation and conversion rates. Your work will directly impact our ability to make informed decisions and improve the performance of our websites.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze, and report on website performance, focusing on conversion rates, form submissions, and user engagement.
  • Interpret data from website tracking tools (Google Analytics, VWO, Hubspot).
  • Setting and ideation for web events based on business objectives.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards to provide real‑time insights into website performance and translate data into clear, actionable recommendations for the marketing team (LookerStudio, Superset).
  • Conducting A/B testing analyses (VWO and HubSpot).
  • One‑off analysis for key initiatives like Back Friday campaign, promotions, product launches, website migrations to measure effectiveness.
  • Identify and analyse different audience segments to improve targeting and personalisation.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to ensure that tracking plans are in place for all key user behaviours.
  • Collaborate with the content team to provide data‑driven insights that inform content creation and optimise engagement from key user segments.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years experience in web analytics, digital marketing, or CRO roles.
  • Proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, or other web analytics platforms.
  • Ability to build dashboards and reports using Looker, Tableau, Superset or similar tools.
  • Experience with A/B testing tools like Google Optimize, VWO, or Optimizely.
  • Experience with Hotjar, Clarity, or other user behaviour tracking tools.
  • Experience with Search Console or other SEO tracking tools is a plus.
  • Experience working in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

Career Growth

We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross‑functional projects.

Global Team

  • Formação: Curso técnico em enfermagem completo.
  • Registro no COREN RJ ativo e em regularidade.
  • Experiência nas atividades do Serviço de Apoio Diagnóstico Terapêutico.

Atividades

  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao paciente internado no setor, realizando procedimentos diversos, tais como: higiene ocular, oral, íntima e corporal, aferição de peso, medições de diurese, administração de medicamentos, mudança de decúbito, aspiração de vias aéreas superiores, traqueostomia e tubo orofaríngeo, troca de curativos, administração de contraste oral e venoso, realização das fichas de transferência interna entre setores, aferição de sinais vitais, acompanhamento de pacientes durante transporte, entre outros, conforme definido nos POPs (Procedimento Operacional Padrão) definidos pela Unidade, visando resolver todas as intercorrências necessárias;
  • Separar os materiais necessários e auxiliar os Médicos ou Enfermeiros nos procedimentos realizados, tais como: punções venosas profundas, punções arteriais médias, intubações, realização de exames e procedimentos invasivos, entre outras, bem como providenciando o descarte dos materiais utilizados.
  • Prestar vigilância intensiva aos pacientes sob seu cuidado, notificando imediatamente aos enfermeiros e registrando na evolução e balanço hídrico qualquer intercorrência, para fins de controle.
  • Cumprir as orientações definidas em prescrição médica, para preparo dos pacientes para realização de exames e/ou cirurgias, tais como manutenção de jejum, preparo de cólon, realização de bióspia, entre outros, a fim de garantir a continuidade do tratamento.
  • Instalar no paciente os equipamentos de monitorização, como bombas infusoras e monitores cardíacos, conforme orientação médica.
  • Realizar a aplicação de compressas quentes e frias, conforme prescrição médica, assegurando a integridade cutânea do paciente.
  • Observar reações adversas à administração de medicamentos, incluindo contrastes, realizando os registros e cuidados adequados aos casos além da comunicação com a equipe médica e de enfermeiros;
  • Providenciar a devolução dos medicamentos e materiais não utilizados pelos pacientes, fazendo lançamento através do Sistema Phostos, garantindo a confirmação do processo.
  • Checar todos os medicamentos prescritos e administrados, lançando no balanço hídrico horário de início de dieta, transporte de soluções, infusões, medicações SOS e ACM, assim como valor de glicemia, diurese e eliminações, controlar o balanço hídrico rigorosamente.
  • Verificar os pacientes em precaução de contato, assegurando o bloqueio de entrada, com uso correto e rigoroso de EPIs.

Um aeroporto com a alma carioca! O RIOgaleão é o maior equipamento urbano do Rio de Janeiro, com grande importância para a economia do estado. Ao longo de 10 anos de operação, recebemos mais de 100 milhões de passageiros, fomos o aeroporto Olímpico, vimos a cura da Covid chegar pelo nosso Terminal de Cargas e somos a porta de entrada para os principais eventos da cidade.

Aqui somos contagiados pelo Jeito RIOgaleão de Ser, onde nossos Integrantes atuam com garra e determinação para alcançar resultados, são incentivados a buscar o autodesenvolvimento , sendo agentes do próprio destino profissional, trabalham em equipe com colaboração e empatia e são norteados por um espírito de dono , cuidando e perseguindo sempre os melhores resultados. Nosso Jeito RIOgaleão de Ser abraça a diversidade, por isso, nossos processos seletivos são abertos à todos, afinal trabalhamos todos os dias para a verdadeira conexão.

Se você se identifica com esses valores e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e que adora desafios, temos uma oportunidade como Farmacêutico (a) Jr.

Nesse desafio, desenvolverá suas atividades como Assistente Técnico Farmacêutico, apoiando na garantia das condições ideais de higiene, temperatura e integridade das cargas sob vigilância sanitária que são movimentadas e armazenadas no RIOgaleão Cargo.

  • Apoiar na revisão e manutenção do MANUAL DE BOAS PRÁTICAS do RIOgaleão Cargo;
  • Promover, em alinhamento com Responsável Técnico, as ações que garantam o cumprimento às exigências necessárias à obtenção de certificações voltadas ao segmento farmacêutico;

  • Identificar e armazenar somente as cargas compatíveis no mesmo espaço físico de acordo com a orientação do fabricante, da legislação vigente e/ou na literatura científica dos produtos, evitando contaminação cruzada de produtos;
  • Segregar cargas e descargas dos produtos sujeitos ao controle sanitário e/ou que exijam condições especiais de movimentação, transporte e armazenamento;
  • Conhecer e divulgar as ações previstas nos Planos de Contingência;
  • Participar da análise em processos de pedido de indenização por avarias;
  • Atuar como multiplicador de conhecimento em treinamentos operacionais;
  • Zelar pelo fiel cumprimento dos procedimentos vigentes de forma a garantir o controle, rastreabilidade, integridade e segurança da carga, observando-se os requisitos regulatórios e as boas práticas de armazenagem;

  • Garantir a conformidade dos processos relacionados aos produtos farmacêuticos;
  • Delegar responsabilidade aos supervisores operacionais da conformidade dos processos relacionados a produtos farmacêuticos.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania , como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais 20 pontos do país, atendendo a 06 estados diferentes, sendo Equipo - RJ, Itaipu - MG, Itaipu Norte - PA, Quinta Roda - SP e Supermac - AM e RR.

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos e produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com grande preocupação pela conservação do meio ambiente, as atividades produtivas são executadas visando as melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas e cuidados com as águas e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética.

Com essa aquisição, a WLM amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A localização estratégica das unidades permite uma atuação com abrangente cobertura geográfica, garantindo presteza, qualidade e agilidade no atendimento.

A sua holding está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e possui uma filial corporativa em Minas Gerais, na Cidade de Contagem.

Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!

  • Elabora relatórios de vendas, de promoções, de demonstrações e de pesquisa de preços.
  • Trabalha em conformidade com normas e procedimentos técnicos, de qualidade, de segurança e de preservação do meio ambiente.

Nós somos a Karoon Energy Brasil, seja muito bem-vindo(a)!

A Karoon Energy é uma empresa internacional de exploração e produção de petróleo e gás natural, com projetos no Brasil, no Golfo do México e na Austrália, com ações listadas na bolsa de valores da Austrália.

A companhia detém e opera 100% do Campo de Baúna , localizado ao sul da Bacia de Santos, que compreende os reservatórios de Baúna, Piracaba e Patola. A companhia também detém os campos de Neon e Goiá , e o bloco S-M-1537, todos ao sul da Bacia de Santos .

No Golfo da América , a companhia tem uma participação não-operacional de 30% nos campos de petróleo e gás Who Dat e Dome Patrol, 16% no campo Abilene, assim como variadas participações em infraestrutura na área de exploração na costa da Louisiana (EUA).

Nossa visão é ser uma companhia líder e independente de energia, capaz de se adaptar a um mundo dinâmico de maneira inovadora e empreendedora. Nosso propósito é fornecer energia de forma segura, responsável, criando benefícios duradouros para todos os seus stakeholders.

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com apromoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Sitting within the Ticketing Department, Ticketing aims to deliver the most engaging, innovative, and accessible Women’s World Cup experience for all athletes, fans, partners, and the community.

Reporting organizationally to the Head of Ticketing, the Ticketing Sales & Strategy Manager will help serve Ticketing sales, operations and efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil™ 2027 that for the first time ever, will be hosted in South America. Work in close consultation and collaboration with FIFA Zurich.

The Ticketing Sales & Strategy Manager will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive ticket sales strategies to ensure optimal attendance and revenue generation for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 in Brazil. The role requires a strong understanding of the Brazilian sports market, exceptional stakeholder engagement skills, and the ability to drive innovative ticketing initiatives not only across all 8 host cities but in the wider region.

Ensuring an exceptional and consistent approach in the planning phase as well as throughout the tournament.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and execute ticket sales strategies to maximize revenue and stadium occupancy across all venues.
  • Design and implement Ticket Sales Strategy for the project, including but not limited to ticket products, sales phases, and pricing strategies tailored to different market segments.
  • Conduct market analysis to optimise sales projections and adapt pricing dynamically.
  • Collaborate with the ticketing project management as well as the CRM team to ensure strategies and processes are aligned.
  • Collaborate with the FIFA Hospitality team and the Official Hospitality Provider to ensure Hospitality’s product positioning and pricing is integrated into the overall ticketing strategy and objectives.
  • Engage with local communities, fan groups, and host city stakeholders to drive awareness and interest in the tournament.
  • Collaborate with marketing and communications teams to build and ensure the alignment of ticketing and hospitality promotions with overall event campaigns and timelines.
  • Build and manage relationships with domestic stakeholders incl., venue operators, host cities and key stakeholders to optimize ticketing and hospitality opportunities.
  • Monitor ticket sales performance, analyze data, and provide regular reports with insights and recommendations for improvement, with a particular focus on strategies to increase sales, attendance, and overall revenue.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA ticketing standards, operational guidelines, and relevant regulations.
  • Conduct post-event analysis to capture learnings for future FIFA tournaments.

Your profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent in Business Administration, Sport Management, Marketing, Economics or relevant area.

Experience

  • 5+ years’ experience in: Ticket sales for major sports events; including but not limited to the definition of the strategies to increase sales, attendance and revenues – preferably with experience in the Brazilian market.
  • Planning and delivery of a similar project

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of Brazilian market trends and ticketing legislation
  • Ability to design and execute ticketing strategies that maximize revenue and stadium occupancy.
  • Understanding dynamic pricing, market segmentation, and sales optimization in a large scale event context.
  • Strong skills in developing ticketing products, packages, and pricing models that drive demand.
  • Ability to translate data insights into actionable strategies Diplomatic , able to create and nurture stakeholder relationships.
  • Courteous with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive, organised, resilient.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, and as part of a team.
  • Good numerical and time management skills.
  • Ability to prioritise, and be assertive where necessary.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Flexible working hours, readiness for stand-by duty.
  • Willingness to travel.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Join to apply for the Digital Media QA Specialist role at Launch Potato .

Who Are We?

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data‑driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote‑first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high‑growth, high‑performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

Why Join Us?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high‑performers.

Contract Non‑Negotiables

  • You’re available to work 40 hours per week, Monday ‑ Friday.
  • You’re comfortable working somewhere between 7:00 am to 6:00 pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • You have outstanding communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills and are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • You're highly detail‑oriented and reliable.
  • You have excellent administrative skills with the ability to multitask and adapt in a fast‑paced remote environment.

Base Salary

$1,500 ‑ $2,500 (USD) per month.

Your Role

You are a detail‑oriented, results‑driven professional with a passion for maintaining the highest standards of quality and efficiency in operational processes and procedures. Everything goes through QA, so you will be directly responsible for ensuring the success of our campaign launches which connects millions of consumers to our clients monthly! You will also be responsible for overseeing and optimizing our operations to ensure they meet and exceed industry standards and organizational objectives. Your unwavering attention to detail and thorough analysis skills will be invaluable in detecting and identifying potential problems within our daily operations. Additionally, you have a proven track record in quality management, process improvement, and possess industry‑specific knowledge. Your ability to collaborate and work cross‑functionally, leveraging your industry‑specific expertise, will enable you to implement effective solutions, making a significant impact on our company's operational excellence.

Success Looks Like

  • Supporting quality assurance for financebuzz.com and allaboutcookies.org domains.
  • Maintaining the currently implemented process for building, setting up, and testing tracking URLs across all campaigns and platforms to ensure the highest quality.
  • Reconciling reporting between internal tracking platforms and external client platforms to ensure proper tracking.
  • Conducting investigations when there is an offer discrepancy or malfunction and finding suitable resolutions.
  • Reviewing platform documentation and internal product setup to find areas of improvement and working with the Operations team to determine next steps to close the gap.
  • Working closely with the Operations team to ensure QA standards are consistently met.
  • Communicating with internal stakeholders on process improvements.
  • Analyzing ad hoc performance reports to improve company efficiency of revenue delivery, product improvement, or general site issues.
  • Monitoring revenue, conversions, impressions, and clicks to ensure proper reporting when a new offer is created, links are changed, or in other necessary circumstances.
  • Monitoring offer goals to ensure all goals are firing properly after creation.

title: Volunteer System Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament.

This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

Key responsibilities

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑the‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organisational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Analista de Operações Médicas I Dispensação
description:
Analista de Operações Médicas I Dispensação

APEPI Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Join to apply for the Analista de Operações Médicas I Dispensação role at APEPI

Na APEPI, trabalhamos com coragem, afeto e compromisso para garantir o acesso à saúde e aos direitos das famílias que acompanhamos.

Estamos com uma nova oportunidade para Analista de Operações Médicas I Dispensação , com atuação presencial na Sede Administrativa, no Rio de Janeiro.

Buscamos uma pessoa com forte capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica de processos, que goste de trabalhar com indicadores, dados e melhoria contínua.

Alguém que atue com rigor técnico , olhar crítico e sensibilidade humana, garantindo que cada etapa, do recebimento à dispensação dos produtos terapêuticos, aconteça com precisão, rastreabilidade e fluidez operacional.

Mais do que executar, queremos alguém que pense o processo, proponha soluções e faça parte da construção de uma operação de saúde inovadora e comprometida com o cuidado.

Missão do Cargo

O(A) Analista de Operações Médicas é a referência técnica e analítica dos processos de dispensação e logística dos produtos terapêuticos da APEPI.

Sua missão é assegurar rastreabilidade integral, conformidade regulatória e excelência operacional, sustentando o equilíbrio entre eficiência e segurança em toda a jornada do paciente.

Com perfil estruturado e capacidade de análise crítica, este(a) profissional será responsável por monitorar indicadores, revisar fluxos, propor melhorias e apoiar tecnicamente a equipe operacional, garantindo padrões elevados de qualidade, segurança e confiabilidade.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar e assegurar a execução dos processos de dispensação, com foco em rastreabilidade e conformidade das prescrições.
  • Monitorar indicadores operacionais, revisar fluxos e propor melhorias que otimizem tempo e qualidade.
  • Apoiar a equipe técnica na padronização de controles de temperatura, validade, armazenamento e documentação.
  • Supervisionar rotinas da equipe de apoio, garantindo prazos e aderência aos protocolos.
  • Analisar causas de retrabalho e não conformidades, elaborando planos de ação e melhoria contínua.
  • Produzir relatórios gerenciais e análises que apoiem decisões estratégicas.
  • Assegurar conformidade com normas da Anvisa e CRF, garantindo segurança e eficiência na operação.

O que esperamos de você

  • Formação e experiências desejáveis: Ensino superior completo em Logística, Administração, Gestão de Saúde ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em operações de saúde, logística de medicamentos ou produtos controlados.
  • Vivência com controle de estoque, rastreabilidade, auditorias e melhoria de processos.

Conhecimentos e habilidades importantes

  • Ferramentas de gestão e controle.
  • Legislação sanitária e protocolos da Anvisa/CRF.
  • Indicadores de desempenho e relatórios gerenciais.
  • Atenção aos detalhes, raciocínio analítico e comunicação clara.
  • Pós-graduação ou curso de aperfeiçoamento em Gestão de Processos, Qualidade, Logística em Saúde ou Operações.
  • Experiência na elaboração de análises de custos e planos de eficiência operacional.

O que oferecemos

  • Benefícios: Vale alimentação, Vale transporte, Assistência médica, Benefício educacional, Prêmio por assiduidade, Seguro de vida e APEPI Saúde.
  • Modelo de trabalho: Presencial – Sede Administrativa (Rio de Janeiro)
  • Jornada: 40h semanais

Como será o processo seletivo

  • Proposta e início do processo de integração

Inscrições até 18/11
